name: Proclamation
overview: The biblical concept of proclamation is exemplified in King Hezekiah's decree calling all Israel and Judah to observe the Passover in Jerusalem, despite previous neglect of this command (2 Chronicles 30:1-5). This proclamation was a deliberate, king-led initiative to unite the people in returning to the LORD, emphasizing repentance and restoration to covenant faithfulness (2 Chronicles 30:6). The narrative highlights the authority behind proclamation—imperial leadership—and its power to emancipate God's people by inviting them back into fellowship with Him.
